events.title: Iran war cannot end with Revolutionary Guards still in control
events.summary: Any settlement of the Iran war that leaves the Revolutionary Guards in control would preserve the Islamic Republic's core of power and risk turning a military advantage for the US and Israel into a strategic defeat.

events.title: Jailed Iranian Nobel laureate hospitalized after losing consciousness twice
events.summary: Iranian Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi was urgently transferred from Zanjan Prison to a hospital on Friday after losing consciousness twice and suffering a severe deterioration in her health, her lawyer and the Narges Foundation said.

events.title_en: The sphere of work is a vast arena spanning the width of the country; commitment and hard work in the workplace ensure the country's progress
events.summary_en: The sphere of work is a vast arena spanning the width of the country; commitment and hard work in the workplace ensure the country's progress. The sphere of work is a vast arena spanning the width of the country, stretching from inside homes, offices, and business and trade units and mosques to farms and workshops, factories, mines, and many types of service occupations. The more this vast expanse benefits from the two elements of hard work and commitment, which are considered pillars of every great success, the more the country's development is ensured and improved. We know that a worker, in the light of commitment and good deed, sometimes achieves such a position that it is fitting that, just as the kind hand of the teacher and educator, we kiss the capable and skilled hand...

events.title_en: The country's progress is on the wings of the teacher and worker; the future of society is reflected in the conduct and speech of teachers
events.summary_en: The country's progress is on the wings of the teacher and worker; the future of society is reflected in the conduct and speech of teachers. The eleventh and twelfth days of Ordibehesht are days on which the status of the worker and the standing of the teacher are appreciated. Apart from verbal and symbolic tributes, which are in themselves appropriate and right, the progress of any country depends on two wings: knowledge and action. The teacher plays a role in the first stage of achieving this purpose. The grave responsibility of teaching knowledge, increasing skills, and an important part of developing insight and shaping the identity of the next generation falls upon his shoulders. Students and pupils who grow up alongside every teacher will, in the not-too-distant future, apply the skills they have learned and the knowledge they have acquired...

events.title_en: A new chapter in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz — A review of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei's, Leader of the Islamic Revolution's views on managing the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary_en: A new chapter in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz — A review of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei's, Leader of the Islamic Revolution's views on managing the Strait of Hormuz. Vision of the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz: The dawn of a new regional and global order in the light of Iran's resistance measures and the strategy of a strong Iran; No place for foreigners and their mischief in the Persian Gulf; The future of the Persian Gulf: a future without America and in service of the progress, well-being and welfare of the people. Actions in managing the Strait of Hormuz: Use of the tool of blockading the Strait of Hormuz; Practical gratitude for the blessing of exercising control over the Strait by securing the Persian Gulf region; Breaking down the enemy's apparatus of misuse of this waterway. Fruits of the new management of the Strait of Hormuz

events.title: Tehran residents face eviction from hotels after war damage
events.summary: Dozens of residents in Tehran displaced by a 40-day war with the US and Israel said municipal authorities ordered them to vacate temporary hotel housing despite unsafe homes and limited aid, according to interviews published by Etemad newspaper on Thursday.

events.title: United States Condemns the Pro-Hamas Global Sumud Flotilla
events.summary: The United States condemns the Global Sumud Flotilla, a pro-Hamas initiative and a baseless, counterproductive effort to undermine President Trump’s Peace Plan. This Pro-Hamas Flotilla is organized by an OFAC-sanctioned entity, the Popular Conference for Palestinians Abroad, which was designated as a specially designated global terrorist in January for operating at Hamas’ behest. The founder of the Global Sumud Flotilla has publicly expressed support for the Iranian regime and its terror proxies

events.title_en: A new chapter in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz is being written
events.summary_en: A new chapter in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz is being written. Today, two months after the largest military campaign and aggression of the world's bullies in the region and the humiliating defeat of America in its scheme, a new chapter in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz is being written. The peoples of the Persian Gulf region, who for years had become accustomed to the silence and submission of their rulers in the face of bullies and aggressors, have witnessed in the past sixty days the beautiful manifestations of steadfastness, vigilance and valour of the courageous personnel of the Army and Revolutionary Guards naval forces, alongside the zeal and martial spirit of the people and youth of Iran's southern region in rejecting the dominion of foreigners. From the message of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution on the occasion of the National Day of the Persian Gulf

events.title: Iran ranks near bottom as press curbs deepen worldwide
events.summary: Iran ranked among the world’s worst countries for press freedom in 2026 as global conditions hit a 25-year low, with legal pressure on journalists intensifying across multiple regions, Reporters Without Borders said.

events.title: Soaring prices push medicine beyond Iranians' reach
events.summary: Medicine prices in Iran have surged sharply in recent weeks, with some drugs rising by as much as 380%, according to reports received by Iran International, as the country grapples with soaring inflation, a collapsing currency and worsening wartime disruption.
